name: guardrails
description: Blocks risky Bash commands (wait-loops, PR creation, shell writes to source, uncontained builds) and shows every block in /blocked

blockWaitLoops.title: Block wait-loops
blockWaitLoops.description: Deny `until … do sleep …; done` loops, and tell Claude to background the work and wait for its completion notice instead.

blockPrCreation.title: Block PR/MR creation
blockPrCreation.description: Deny `gh pr create`, `glab mr create` and `gh api -X POST …/pulls`, for setups that merge straight to the main branch.

blockShellSourceWrites.title: Block shell writes to source files
blockShellSourceWrites.description: Deny writing a source file through Bash (`sed -i`, redirects, `cp`, `tee`, Python or Node file writes, `curl -o`), so edits go through Read, Edit and Write. Paths under /tmp are exempt.

blockUncontainedBuilds.title: Block uncontained mutation testing
blockUncontainedBuilds.description: Deny `cargo mutants` unless it runs in a systemd scope with MemoryMax, under nice, with TMPDIR off /tmp, at no more than half the cores.
